Notes to the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results
1. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 “Interim Financial Reporting”, prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as amended from time to time, and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.

2. The above unaudited consolidated financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on October 31, 2026. The statutory auditors have carried out a limited review of these financial results and have issued an unmodified limited review report thereon.

3. The consolidated financial results include the financial results of Studds Accessories Limited (“the Holding Company”) and its wholly owned subsidiaries, namely, Bikerz US Inc., incorporated in the United States of America, and SMK Helmets Europe SRL, incorporated in Italy (the Holding Company and its subsidiaries together referred to as “the Group”). SMK Helmets Europe SRL has been consolidated with effect from its date of incorporation, i.e., May 22, 2026; accordingly, the figures for the corresponding periods of the previous year are not strictly comparable. The Group has no other subsidiaries, joint ventures or associates.

4. On May 22, 2026, the Holding Company incorporated a Wholly Owned Subsidiary in Italy, namely, SMK Helmets Europe SRL, with an initial share capital of Rs. 33.51 million (equivalent to EUR 0.30 million).

5. On September 8, 2026, the Holding Company subscribed to 144 additional equity shares of Bikerz US Inc., its wholly owned subsidiary incorporated in the United States of America, for a consideration of Rs. 9.48 million (equivalent to USD 0.10 million). The shares were allotted to the Holding Company on the same date. Bikerz US Inc. continues to be a wholly owned subsidiary following this investment.

6. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Holding Company paid the final dividend of Rs. 3.00 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26, aggregating Rs. 118.06 million, as approved by the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on September 5, 2026.

7. The shareholders of the Holding Company approved the “Studds Accessories Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme 2026” on September 5, 2026. No options were granted under the Scheme up to September 30, 2026.

8. The Group operates in a single reportable segment, i.e., the manufacture and sale of helmets and accessories, in accordance with Ind AS 108 on Operating Segments.

9. Tax expense has been provided based on the estimated effective tax rate for the full financial year, applied to the profit before tax for the period.

10. Earnings per share for the interim period have not been annualised.

11. Previous period figures have been regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary, to conform to the current period’s classification.

12. The Unaudited Consolidated Balance Sheet as at September 30, 2026 and the Unaudited Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows for the half year ended September 30, 2026 form part of these financial results, pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.

13. The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and the year-to-date results for the period from April 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026 are available on the Company’s website at www.studds.com under the Investor Relations Section and on the websites of the stock exchanges, namely, BSE Limited at www.bseindia.com and National Stock Exchange of India Limited at www.nseindia.com.


All XBRL figures are in millions, except figures for Face Value of Equity Share Capital and Earning Per Share are on absolute basis.
